integrity: All-dimensional upper bound is analytic with exact endpoint-leakage case analysis; finite small cases n=2..8 are exhaustively enumerated by embedded exact-integer code; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: One half-lazy update only, finite unweighted paths with degree-one endpoints, real inputs and unweighted complete-pair Gini variation; no sharp claims for repeated steps, other holding probabilities, weighted paths or stationary-weighted Gini variation.
title: Sharp one-step Gini norm for the half-lazy reflecting path walk
